newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Boeing delivers long range 777 to China Southern.
newsitem.headline: Boeing delivers long range 777 to China Southern.

text.p: China Southern Airlines has taken delivery of its first long range Boeing 777 aircraft which will inaugurate the carrier's trans Pacific route later this year, Boeing Co said in a press statement.
The Boeing 777-200IGW (Increased Gross Weight) aircraft is fitted with an extra fuel tank for the 7,800 miles non-stop service from Guangzhou to Los Angeles, it said.
The delivery brings the number of 777-200s -- powered by General Electric GE90 engines -- in China Southern's fleet to five with a sixth scheduled to arrive next month, it added.
The statement said that China Southern has the biggest Boeing fleet in China with 62 aircraft. -- Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax:5017
